messages.content: 如果一個球以5米/秒的速度直接向上投擲，它將達到什麼加速度？

function.name: calculate_maximum_height
function.description: Calculate the maximum height an object will reach if it's thrown straight upwards with an initial velocity, ignoring air resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity in meters per second. This is a float type value.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity in meters per second squared, default value is 9.8. This is a float type value.

message.content:
當你把球「直線往上」拋出，離開手後它不再受到任何外力（假設忽略空氣阻力），唯一作用在球上的力就是重力。  
因此：

| 項目 | 數值 |
|------|-----|
| 重力加速度 \(g\) | 約 \(-9.8~\text{m/s}^{2}\) |

* **符號說明**：負號表示方向與初始運動相反，即下落方向；若只關心大小，可寫作 \(9.8~\text{m/s}^{2}\)。  

所以答案是：球會經歷約 \(9.8\,\mathrm{m/s^{2}}\) 的減速，加速度指向地面。

> 如果想計算最高點高度，可以使用公式  
> \[
> h_{\max}= \frac{{v_0}^2}{2g}
> \]  
> 並帶入 \(v_0=5~\text{m/s},\; g=9.8~\text{m/s}^{2}\)，得到大約 \(1.28~\text{公尺}\)。

但就“加速度”而言，就是上述的 \(9.8~\text{m/s}^{2}\) 向下。
message.reasoning:
The user asks (in Chinese): "If a ball is thrown upward at speed of 5 m/s directly up, what acceleration will it achieve?" They likely mean what's its acceleration? In physics, when throwing upward, the only acceleration acting on the ball after launch is gravitational acceleration downward (~ -9.81 m/s^2). So answer: acceleration magnitude ~9.8 m/s² downwards.

But maybe they want to compute max height using given tool. But question specifically about acceleration. Provide explanation and mention negative sign indicates direction opposite motion. Also note no other forces considered. Could also ask to use function but not needed because we just give constant g. We can optionally call function to confirm? Not necessary. We'll respond accordingly.
